issue.title: Restore bd/work_task follow-up guidance or align its tests and docs
issue.description: Discovered while running just check after an unrelated file-hook filter migration on 2026-08-08. just check escalated to the full suite because src/sase/config/sase.schema.json changed, then failed only two bead xprompt tests: tests/test_bead_xprompt_tags.py::test_bead_worker_builtin_xprompts_do_not_author_wait_directives[bd/work_task-Can you complete the work for task bead {{ bead_id }}] and tests/test_bead_xprompt_tags.py::test_builtin_task_prompt_routes_distinct_follow_ups_through_skill. The same two failures reproduce in isolation with '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_bead_xprompt_tags.py::test_bead_worker_builtin_xprompts_do_not_author_wait_directives tests/test_bead_xprompt_tags.py::test_builtin_task_prompt_routes_distinct_follow_ups_through_skill -q'. Root evidence: commit 72ec6aa3a ('feat: Update the #bd/work_task xprompt') changed only src/sase/default_config.yml and replaced the task prompt text, removing both the old 'Can you complete the work for task bead {{ bead_id }}' wording and the instruction to use /sase_new_task for genuinely distinct follow-up work. Impact: full-suite validation is red for unrelated agents, and task workers no longer receive the documented follow-up-routing instruction (docs/xprompt.md still says #bd/work_task routes distinct follow-ups through /sase_new_task). Scope: decide whether the new prompt wording is intentional; either restore equivalent follow-up guidance and update the tests to the new stable wording, or deliberately update the tests and docs if task workers should no longer be told to use /sase_new_task.
